SELECT
  c.id,
  c.name,
  c.email,
  c.company_name,
  c.industry,
  c.created_at,
  c.updated_at,
  COUNT(DISTINCT bp.id) AS brand_profile_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS post_count
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN brand_profiles bp ON bp.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.email, c.company_name, c.industry, c.created_at, c.updated_at
ORDER BY c.id DESC
LIMIT 100;

UPDATE posts
SET status = 'published', published_at = NOW()
WHERE status = 'scheduled'
  AND scheduled_at IS NOT NULL
  AND scheduled_at <= NOW();

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (workflow_name, event_type, status, input_payload, output_payload)
VALUES (
  'Run Schedule Simulation',
  'run_schedule_simulation',
  'success',
  JSON_OBJECT('run_at', NOW()),
  JSON_OBJECT('message', 'Due scheduled posts marked as published')
);

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers) AS customer_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM brand_profiles) AS brand_profile_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts) AS post_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE status = 'draft') AS draft_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE status = 'scheduled') AS scheduled_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE status = 'published') AS published_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE status = 'failed') AS failed_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_logs) AS workflow_log_count;
